_help: Art direction and manual content. rail: media IDs for the four hero Reels, in order (falls back to the newest). hero: IDs for the generated hero loops. lanes: {id: comedy|ads|sport}. captions_en: {id: "English pitch"} or {id: {"pitch": "...", "more": "..."}}; always wins over the machine translation in data/translations.json.

guide._help: Examples in /guide/, by Reel media ID. Views, posters and videos come from the manifest at build time. hide_views: sector keys whose card shows no view count. og: covers for og-guide-*.jpg.
